theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (x : Rn N) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∀ (A : Set (Rn N)) (g : Rn N → ℝ), ∫ y in blowUpMap x r '' A, g y ∂μHE[n] = (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z in A, g (blowUpMap x r z) ∂μHE[n]
